title: AutoPay Discount Withdrawn at Grace Cure — Premium Billing Accounts Terms
content:
**Term.** On Premium Billing Accounts, an AutoPay discount already given on past-due months is withdrawn and added to the grace-cure payment in the cases below; the first case that holds decides. This amount is added to the past-due premium; the total, after any deduction, is floored at 0.00 and rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

1. When two or more payments of the account by bank draft (EFT) or card were returned within twelve months before the payment date, and the account left AutoPay: twice the AutoPay arrangement's monthly discount of 1.00 — that is, 2.00 — is added, for the oldest past-due month and the month after it, both billed with the discount.
2. When the arrangement carries an AutoPay discount (only Cascade Individual AutoPay Monthly, at 1.00 a month) and a payment taken as a grace-cure payment was received on or after the grace-period start date: the arrangement's monthly AutoPay discount, 1.00, is added once, for the oldest past-due month.
3. Otherwise nothing is added.

The account *left AutoPay* when its arrangement carries no AutoPay discount and does not accept bank draft (EFT), and the account nevertheless collected at least one regular automatic draft within twelve months before the payment date — which only the AutoPay arrangement it was moved from when automatic draft was removed could have collected. A record falls within a number of months before the payment date when the whole calendar months from its date to the payment date, counted the way an anniversary is counted (a month is complete only when a later month reaches the same day number, and the last day of a shorter month does not complete it), are fewer than that number. A payment is received on or after the grace-period start date when its receipt date is that date or later.

**Truth table**
| Returns by EFT or card within twelve months | Left AutoPay | Arrangement carries AutoPay discount | Grace-cure payment received on or after grace start | Added |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2 or more | yes | no | — | 2.00 |
| 1 or none | yes | no | — | nothing |
| — | no | yes | yes | 1.00 |
| — | no | yes | no | nothing |
| — | no | no | — | nothing |

**Hypothetical case.** An account moved from Cascade Individual AutoPay Monthly to Cascade Individual Direct Bill Monthly after its drafts were returned in January and March; it collected a regular automatic draft in December of the prior year; payment date in August: two returns within twelve months and the account left AutoPay — 2.00 is added.
